'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Mike d'Amboise DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike d'Amboise]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]] · [[According to My Design]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-mike-damboise-ds-watto/ PC list]
